title: Campus Latches
texts: Jump and latch using campus rungs

CAUTION:  This workout is intended for advanced climbers (those comfortable climbing at least V8/7B and up) and should only be completed by healthy, non-injured, individuals after a thorough warm-up.  This session should not be completed at the end of a climbing session or while tired.

Using a campus board, jump to a rung of your choice using one arm and “latch” the hold, maintaining control for 1-2 seconds before dropping off.  Make sure that you maintain a slight bend in your elbow when latching the hold (approximately a 120-degree angle).  Complete 3 jumps on the right side, resting 10 seconds between attempts, before repeating on the other side.  Rest for 2 minutes between sets before repeating this process again for 2 additional sets.  In total, you will complete 3 sets with 3 latches per side, for a total of 18 latches.

If you are unable to latch the rung and maintain control, switch to using a large rung.  If you are still unable to latch and hold the rung, switch to using two arms.  Elite climbers may make this workout more challenging by using a smaller rung size.
